cartridge_name.note: Cartridge designation as the compilation tables spell it.

standard_body.note: Which body published the figure being overridden. Upper case, because these are the body's own name as they write it. Mirrors the CHECK constraint on cartridge_pressure_references.standard_body in data/schema/009.

method.note: Which measurement method the figure refers to. SAAMI and CIP both publish piezo and copper-crusher maxima, and they are not interchangeable - an override that ignored this would silently replace a piezo figure with a copper-crusher one. Mirrors the CHECK constraint in data/schema/009; the loader derives this from pressure_unit ('cup' -> copper_crusher) for the compilation files.

corrected_value.note: The value that should be used instead. Always read with unit.

basis.note: Why this override exists. Required, not optional: an override with no stated basis is indistinguishable from a guess, and a guess that outranks the compilations is the worst possible failure mode for pressure data. - primary: read from the standards body's own current table. - compilation: taken from a published compilation, not the body itself. - known_error: the compilation figure is believed wrong.

source_url.note: Where the corrected figure was read.

reviewer_note.note: Why the correction was made. May contain commas; keep quoted.

rows.reviewer_note: kwk.us lists 52 ksi for 6.5 Creedmoor SAAMI. That is a transposition of 62. SAAMI Z299.4-2025 gives 62,000 psi and CIP gives 63,091 psi (4,350 bar); the CIP figure is independently corroborated by CIP TDCC. The archived local copy data/published/saami-z299.4-2025-centerfire-rifle.pdf is the authority; open it and confirm before relying on this row.
